Jennifer — thanks for the note and the clear asks. High-level reply below; I'll follow up with a short readout doc and a proposed schedule.

Answers / plan (top-of-mind):
- Deployment scoping: most administrative/process controls map uniformly across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Technical controls (network segmentation, KMS/HSM custody, snapshots) differ by deployment: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) have distinct control owners and will require customer-provided network diagrams and KMS attestations. Dedicated customers use our isolated GPU pools — we can provide audit-friendly snapshots for that environment. Hosted artifacts are available centrally (we can provide console access patterns and snapshots).
- Gaps: we have an ongoing workstream around key rotation documentation for some older model-serving integrations. We're mid-update on the KMS key-rotation runbook; I'll flag this as an action item.
- Logs: we can produce time-bounded log bundles (redwood_snapshot_logs_202804.tgz) and curated search screenshots for Cloud Logging / S3 retention policies.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal kick: 30-min call with Acme + Redwood (Irene for technical scope, Kimberly for policy/evidence owners).
2) Deliverable list by Fri (2028-05-24) — I'll attach a control-mapping export and an evidence table.
3) Dry-run week scheduling the week of Jun 12 (confirm auditor availability).

I'll attach a quick control-mapping link and a draft owner matrix in a follow-up. Is a 30-min sync on Tuesday (2028-05-22) at 10:00am PT okay?

Thanks,

Thanks for looping us in. A few technical clarifications and artifact callouts for Acme to consider when finalizing scope: 

1) Control split by deployment (short):
- Hosted: centralized logging, multi-tenant network perimeter controls, centralized KMS (we provide key management logs and key rotation schedules). Evidence: console exports, snapshot bundles, and redact-safe log samples.
- Dedicated: isolated GPU pools; we can provide a complete snapshot (disk + runtime) under NDA for the dedicated tenant. Evidence: dedicated snapshot archive + KMS attestations.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed network diagrams + access to host-level snapshots (if on-prem, we need to coordinate a handoff window).

2) Specific artifacts we'll prepare for the dry-run: 
- redwood_snapshot_logs_202804.tgz (time-windowed tokenized logs; trimmed PII)
- network_diagram_v2.pdf (shows cross-region routing for us/eu)
- s3-bucket-policy-screenshots.png (retention & object-level ACLs)
- kms_key_rotation_runbook_v1.docx (we are finalizing v2)

3) Known gaps / mitigation: 
- KMS runbook: in progress — target completion 2028-06-05. We'll surface the interim runbook and a mitigation note for auditors.
- Enclave snapshot retention: older snapshots (pre-2027) are in cold storage and may require extraction time; we'll highlight any retrieval SLAs.

4) Evidence access model: Most artifacts can be delivered as file bundles. For controls that require live console demonstration, we can run a short (10–15 min) session and record it; please flag which items must be live.
